entities.summary: Charlotte Baunbæk Dyremose is a Danish Conservative politician and a Church of Denmark pastor. She was a member of the Folketing from 2001 to 2011 and from 2013 to 2015. Among her parliamentary responsibilities, she was spokeswoman for ecclesiastical affairs. Dyremose was ordained in Helsingør Cathedral in June 2019 and as of December 2023 serves as a pastor in Hellerup Church.
